import numpy as np
import chess
np.random.seed\(0\)

from config import Config
from evolution import init_populations, aggregate_fitness_for_side, evolve_populations, snapshot_elites, sample_opponent
from game_engine import play_game

cfg = Config\(games_per_generation=3, max_turns=200\)
white_pops = init_populations\(cfg\)
black_pops = init_populations\(cfg\)
white_ema = {k: np.zeros\(cfg.population_size\) for k in white_pops}
black_ema = {k: np.zeros\(cfg.population_size\) for k in black_pops}
white_hof = [snapshot_elites\(white_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)]
black_hof = [snapshot_elites\(black_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)]
training_side = chess.WHITE

for gen in range\(5\):
    if training_side == chess.WHITE:
        train_pops = white_pops
        opp_pops = sample_opponent\(black_hof, black_pops\)
        wp, bp = train_pops, opp_pops
    else:
        train_pops = black_pops
        opp_pops = sample_opponent\(white_hof, white_pops\)
        wp, bp = opp_pops, train_pops

    results = [play_game\(wp, bp, cfg\) for _ in range\(cfg.games_per_generation\)]
    
    # Verify finite fitness
    for r in results:
        for pr in r['piece_results']:
            assert np.isfinite\(pr['fitness']\), f'Non-finite fitness at gen {gen}'
    
    mean_fit = aggregate_fitness_for_side\(results, train_pops, training_side\)
    ema = white_ema if training_side == chess.WHITE else black_ema
    new_pops, elite_fit, new_ema = evolve_populations\(train_pops, mean_fit, ema, cfg, gen\)
    
    # Verify reproduction
    for key, pop in new_pops.items\(\):
        assert len\(pop\) == cfg.population_size, f'Wrong pop size at gen {gen}'
    
    snap = snapshot_elites\(new_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)
    if training_side == chess.WHITE:
        white_pops = new_pops
        white_ema = new_ema
        white_hof.append\(snap\)
    else:
        black_pops = new_pops
        black_ema = new_ema
        black_hof.append\(snap\)
    
    avg_fit = np.mean\([v for v in elite_fit.values\(\)]\)
    print\(f'Gen {gen+1} \({\\"white\\" if training_side == chess.WHITE else \\"black\\"}\): elite_fit_avg={avg_fit:.4f}'\)
    training_side = chess.BLACK if training_side == chess.WHITE else chess.WHITE

print\(\)
print\('5-generation integration test PASSED — no errors, finite fitness, correct reproduction.'\)
")

import pickle, numpy as np, chess
from config import Config
from game_engine import play_game
from evolution import PIECE_TYPE_NAMES, ALL_PIECE_TYPES

with open\('/tmp/trained_pops.pkl', 'rb'\) as f:
    data = pickle.load\(f\)
wp, bp = data['wp'], data['bp']

cfg = Config\(\)
np.random.seed\(99\)

# Run 30 games with full logs for move-selection + voting analysis
games_log = [play_game\(wp, bp, cfg, log_detail=True\) for _ in range\(30\)]

# Move selection frequency from logs
type_selected = {pt: 0 for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
type_votes_for = {pt: 0 for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}   # how many weighted votes each type received
type_voted_for_by = {}  # \(voter_type, target_type\) -> count — who votes for whom

total_turns = 0
for g in games_log:
    for tlog in g['turn_logs']:
        spt = tlog['selected_piece_type']
        type_selected[spt] = type_selected.get\(spt, 0\) + 1
        total_turns += 1
        # Track weighted votes going to each piece type
        # vote_counts: slot_id -> weighted_votes
        # We need slot_id -> piece_type mapping; use piece_results
        slot_to_type = {}
        for pr in g['piece_results']:
            slot_to_type[pr['slot_id']] = pr['original_piece_type']
        for slot_id, wvotes in tlog['vote_counts'].items\(\):
            if slot_id in slot_to_type and wvotes > 0:
                target_pt = slot_to_type[slot_id]
                type_votes_for[target_pt] = type_votes_for.get\(target_pt, 0\) + wvotes
        # who voted for what type
        for voter_pt, voted_slot in tlog['votes'].items\(\):
            if voted_slot in slot_to_type:
                target_pt = slot_to_type[voted_slot]
                key = \(voter_pt, target_pt\)
                type_voted_for_by[key] = type_voted_for_by.get\(key, 0\) + 1

print\('=== MOVE SELECTION FREQUENCY \(30 games, logged\) ==='\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    pct = type_selected[pt] / max\(total_turns, 1\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8}: {pct:.1%}  \({type_selected[pt]} turns\)'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== WEIGHTED VOTE SHARE RECEIVED \(which types attract most votes\) ==='\)
total_wvotes = sum\(type_votes_for.values\(\)\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    pct = type_votes_for.get\(pt, 0\) / max\(total_wvotes, 1\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8}: {pct:.1%}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== VOTING MATRIX \(voter type -> target type, row = voter, col = target\) ==='\)
voter_types = ALL_PIECE_TYPES
header = '          ' + ''.join\(f'{PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt][:4]:>8}' for pt in voter_types\)
print\(header\)
for voter_pt in voter_types:
    row_total = sum\(type_voted_for_by.get\(\(voter_pt, tgt\), 0\) for tgt in voter_types\)
    row = f'  {PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[voter_pt]:<8}'
    for tgt_pt in voter_types:
        ct = type_voted_for_by.get\(\(voter_pt, tgt_pt\), 0\)
        pct = ct / max\(row_total, 1\)
        row += f'{pct:>8.0%}'
    print\(row\)

# Piece mobility over game phases
print\(\)
print\('=== GAME PHASE ANALYSIS ==='\)
early_caps = 0; late_caps = 0
for g in games_log:
    gl = g['game_length']
    for pr in g['piece_results']:
        if pr['captured']:
            t = pr['capture_turn']
            if t < gl * 0.33:
                early_caps += 1
            elif t > gl * 0.66:
                late_caps += 1

total_caps = sum\(1 for g in games_log for pr in g['piece_results'] if pr['captured']\)
print\(f'  Total captures: {total_caps}'\)
print\(f'  Captured in first third of game:  {early_caps} \({early_caps/max\(total_caps,1\):.0%}\)'\)
print\(f'  Captured in final third of game:  {late_caps}  \({late_caps/max\(total_caps,1\):.0%}\)'\)

# Capture rates by piece type
print\(\)
print\('=== CAPTURE RATES BY TYPE \(% of games where piece makes at least 1 capture\) ==='\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    n = sum\(1 for g in games_log for pr in g['piece_results'] if pr['original_piece_type']==pt\)
    capturers = sum\(1 for g in games_log for pr in g['piece_results'] if pr['original_piece_type']==pt and pr['capture_value']>0\)
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8}: {capturers/max\(n,1\):.0%} of pieces make >= 1 capture  \(avg material captured: {sum\(pr[\\"capture_value\\"] for g in games_log for pr in g[\\"piece_results\\"] if pr[\\"original_piece_type\\"]==pt\)/max\(n,1\):.2f}\)'\)
" 2>&1)

import numpy as np, chess, time, pickle
from config import Config
from evolution import \(init_populations, aggregate_fitness_for_side, evolve_populations,
                       snapshot_elites, sample_opponent, population_weight_variance, PIECE_TYPE_NAMES\)
from game_engine import play_game

np.random.seed\(42\)
cfg = Config\(beta=5.0\)
print\(f'beta={cfg.beta}, alpha={cfg.alpha}, kappa={cfg.kappa}'\)

white_pops = init_populations\(cfg\)
black_pops = init_populations\(cfg\)
white_ema = {k: np.zeros\(cfg.population_size\) for k in white_pops}
black_ema = {k: np.zeros\(cfg.population_size\) for k in black_pops}
white_hof = [snapshot_elites\(white_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)]
black_hof = [snapshot_elites\(black_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)]
training_side = chess.WHITE

N_GENS = 60
t_start = time.time\(\)

for gen in range\(N_GENS\):
    if training_side == chess.WHITE:
        train_pops, opp_pops = white_pops, sample_opponent\(black_hof, black_pops\)
        wp, bp = train_pops, opp_pops
    else:
        train_pops, opp_pops = black_pops, sample_opponent\(white_hof, white_pops\)
        wp, bp = opp_pops, train_pops

    results = [play_game\(wp, bp, cfg\) for _ in range\(cfg.games_per_generation\)]
    mean_fit = aggregate_fitness_for_side\(results, train_pops, training_side\)
    ema_key = white_ema if training_side == chess.WHITE else black_ema
    new_pops, elite_fit, new_ema = evolve_populations\(train_pops, mean_fit, ema_key, cfg, gen\)

    snap = snapshot_elites\(new_pops, k=cfg.elite_count\)
    if training_side == chess.WHITE:
        white_pops = new_pops; white_ema = new_ema
        white_hof.append\(snap\)
        if len\(white_hof\) > cfg.hall_of_fame_size: white_hof.pop\(0\)
        wvar = population_weight_variance\(white_pops\)
    else:
        black_pops = new_pops; black_ema = new_ema
        black_hof.append\(snap\)
        if len\(black_hof\) > cfg.hall_of_fame_size: black_hof.pop\(0\)
        wvar = population_weight_variance\(black_pops\)

    outcomes = [r['board_result'] for r in results]
    side = 'W' if training_side == chess.WHITE else 'B'
    best_fit = max\(elite_fit.values\(\)\)
    print\(f'Gen {gen+1:2d} \({side}\) | best_fit={best_fit:.3f} | var={wvar:.5f} | '
          f'W:{outcomes.count\(\\"1-0\\"\)} B:{outcomes.count\(\\"0-1\\"\)} '
          f'D:{outcomes.count\(\\"1/2-1/2\\"\)} TO:{outcomes.count\(\\"timeout\\"\)} | {time.time\(\)-t_start:.0f}s'\)

    training_side = chess.BLACK if training_side == chess.WHITE else chess.WHITE
    if wvar < cfg.convergence_threshold:
        print\(f'Converged at gen {gen+1}'\)
        break

print\(f'Total: {time.time\(\)-t_start:.0f}s'\)
with open\('/tmp/trained_pops_beta5.pkl', 'wb'\) as f:
    pickle.dump\({'wp': white_pops, 'bp': black_pops, 'cfg': cfg}, f\)
print\('Saved.'\)

from config import Config
from game_engine import play_game
from evolution import PIECE_TYPE_NAMES, ALL_PIECE_TYPES

with open\('/tmp/trained_pops_beta5.pkl', 'rb'\) as f:
    data = pickle.load\(f\)
wp, bp, cfg = data['wp'], data['bp'], data['cfg']

np.random.seed\(99\)
N = 100
games = [play_game\(wp, bp, cfg\) for _ in range\(N\)]
games_log = [play_game\(wp, bp, cfg, log_detail=True\) for _ in range\(30\)]

# ── Outcomes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
outcomes = [g['board_result'] for g in games]
lengths  = [g['game_length'] for g in games]
print\('OUTCOMES'\)
print\(f'  White wins : {outcomes.count\(\\"1-0\\"\)}'\)
print\(f'  Black wins : {outcomes.count\(\\"0-1\\"\)}'\)
print\(f'  Draw       : {outcomes.count\(\\"1/2-1/2\\"\)}'\)
print\(f'  Timeout    : {outcomes.count\(\\"timeout\\"\)}'\)
print\(f'  Avg length : {np.mean\(lengths\):.1f}  median={np.median\(lengths\):.0f}'\)

# ── Per-type stats ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type_surv  = {pt: [] for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
type_cap   = {pt: [] for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
type_fit   = {pt: [] for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
for g in games:
    for pr in g['piece_results']:
        pt = pr['original_piece_type']
        type_surv[pt].append\(pr['turns_survived']\)
        type_cap[pt].append\(pr['capture_value']\)
        type_fit[pt].append\(pr['fitness']\)

# survival milestones
avg_len = np.mean\(lengths\)
print\('\\nPER-TYPE'\)
print\(f'  {\\"Type\\":<8} {\\"AvgSurv\\":>8} {\\"SurvEnd\\":>8} {\\"AvgCapt\\":>8} {\\"AvgFit\\":>8}'\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    a_end = np.mean\([s >= avg_len*0.95 for s in type_surv[pt]]\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8} {np.mean\(type_surv[pt]\):>8.1f} {a_end:>8.1%} {np.mean\(type_cap[pt]\):>8.2f} {np.mean\(type_fit[pt]\):>8.3f}'\)

# survival milestones
print\('\\nSURVIVAL MILESTONES'\)
print\(f'  {\\"Type\\":<8} {\\"@50\\":>8} {\\"@100\\":>8} {\\"@150\\":>8}'\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    a50  = np.mean\([s >= 50  for s in type_surv[pt]]\)
    a100 = np.mean\([s >= 100 for s in type_surv[pt]]\)
    a150 = np.mean\([s >= 150 for s in type_surv[pt]]\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8} {a50:>8.1%} {a100:>8.1%} {a150:>8.1%}'\)

# capture activity
print\('\\nCAPTURE ACTIVITY'\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    n = len\(type_cap[pt]\)
    capturers = sum\(1 for g in games for pr in g['piece_results'] if pr['original_piece_type']==pt and pr['capture_value']>0\)
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8}: {capturers/n:.0%} making>=1 capture  avg_mat={np.mean\(type_cap[pt]\):.2f}'\)

# game phase captures
early = mid = late = total = 0
for g in games:
    gl = g['game_length']
    for pr in g['piece_results']:
        if pr['captured']:
            total += 1
            t = pr['capture_turn']
            if t < gl*0.33: early += 1
            elif t > gl*0.66: late += 1
            else: mid += 1
print\(f'\\nCAPTURE TIMING: early={early/max\(total,1\):.0%} mid={mid/max\(total,1\):.0%} late={late/max\(total,1\):.0%} total={total}'\)

# move selection & voting from logs
type_selected = {pt: 0 for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
type_votes_for = {pt: 0 for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES}
type_voted_for_by = {}
total_turns = 0
for g in games_log:
    slot_to_type = {pr['slot_id']: pr['original_piece_type'] for pr in g['piece_results']}
    for tlog in g['turn_logs']:
        spt = tlog['selected_piece_type']
        type_selected[spt] = type_selected.get\(spt,0\) + 1
        total_turns += 1
        for slot_id, wvotes in tlog['vote_counts'].items\(\):
            if slot_id in slot_to_type and wvotes > 0:
                type_votes_for[slot_to_type[slot_id]] = type_votes_for.get\(slot_to_type[slot_id],0\) + wvotes
        for voter_pt, voted_slot in tlog['votes'].items\(\):
            if voted_slot in slot_to_type:
                key = \(voter_pt, slot_to_type[voted_slot]\)
                type_voted_for_by[key] = type_voted_for_by.get\(key,0\)+1

print\('\\nMOVE SELECTION'\)
for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    name = PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt].capitalize\(\)
    print\(f'  {name:<8}: {type_selected[pt]/max\(total_turns,1\):.1%}  \({type_selected[pt]} turns\)'\)

print\('\\nVOTING MATRIX \(voter->target %\)'\)
print\('          ' + ''.join\(f'{PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[pt][:4]:>8}' for pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES\)\)
for voter_pt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES:
    row_total = sum\(type_voted_for_by.get\(\(voter_pt,tgt\),0\) for tgt in ALL_PIECE_TYPES\)
    row = f'  {PIECE_TYPE_NAMES[voter_pt]:<8}'

        ct = type_voted_for_by.get\(\(voter_pt,tgt_pt\),0\)
        row += f'{ct/max\(row_total,1\):>8.0%}'
